# Space Exploration Technologies Corp.
## Notable Price Movement
Despite a successful Starship Flight 13 test (deploying 20 Starlink V3 satellites and achieving its softest splashdown yet) and Morgan Stanley reiterating a bullish $300 price target arguing the market is assigning 'zero value' to SpaceX's AI business, bearish sentiment has persisted, with short sellers reportedly up $15.5 billion in profit and peer Rocket Lab outperforming after landing a major Space Force contract, highlighting a rotation toward tangible execution over speculative growth stories.

SpaceX shares rebounded modestly (+2.6%) after Wednesday's steep 6.7% drop, though gains reversed in after-hours trading (-1.77%) as the company delayed its highly anticipated 13th Starship test flight from Thursday to Friday due to weather conditions hampering heat-shield imaging.

## The original article, preserved
### A $1.75 Trillion IPO Would Be Overpaying 30% for SpaceX
A longer-term forecast of whether Starlink can grow from 9.2M subscribers to 50M+ while expanding revenue per user through enterprise, maritime, aviation, and direct-to-cell channels is critical.

```text
Break SpaceX into its major business segments and forecast the fair market value of each one in billions USD, as of the planned June 2026 IPO. Treat each segment as if it were a standalone company. Then sum the medians, add cash, subtract debt, and compare to the rumored $1.75 trillion IPO target.
```
